# Ruminate X: AI film studio for brand films and AI commercials

> Ruminate X is an AI film studio in Calgary, Canada, founded in 2024 by Abhi Chawla. It makes brand films and AI commercials for consumer brands, pharma and pharmacy companies, labs, medical companies and other businesses. Every frame it delivers is made with generative AI. There are no film crews, sets or location shoots.

## Identity

- **Company type:** AI film studio (AI video production)
- **Founded:** 2024
- **Founder:** Abhi Chawla
- **Location:** Calgary, Alberta, Canada
- **Tagline:** No idea is impossible.

## What Ruminate X makes

- **Brand films:** a story-driven film about what a brand stands for
- **AI commercials:** ads for TV, streaming, web and social
- **About-us and company films:** a film that introduces a company, its mission or its work
- **Avatar videos:** a presenter or spokesperson video made with AI
- **UGC-style ads:** ads in the style of creator videos
- **Review-style videos:** review and testimonial-style videos
- **Product visuals:** product films and stills

## How the work is made

Every frame Ruminate X delivers is made with generative AI. Clients brief the studio; the studio handles the concept, script, boards, generation, edit, sound and grade. The published process is at https://www.ruminatex.com/how-we-make-an-ai-brand-film.

Prices and turnaround are quoted per project. Ruminate X does not publish a price list.

## Who hires Ruminate X

Brand and marketing managers, founders, communications teams and agency producers at consumer brands, pharma and pharmacy companies, labs, medical companies and other businesses.

- [AI Corporate Video Production for Companies](https://www.ruminatex.com/ai-video-production-enterprise): which company films (about-us, mission, conference openers, recruiting, executive messages, training) can be made with AI and which need a camera, enterprise AI video platforms against a studio (security, ownership, commercial-use questions), published corporate video prices, consent and disclosure for AI presenters

- [AI UGC Ads Agency for Brands](https://www.ruminatex.com/ai-ugc-reels): what an AI UGC ad is; published prices from an AI UGC agency (Admiral Media), a self-serve tool (Creatify) and real creators (Collabstr); FTC reviews rule and Endorsement Guides, TikTok and Meta AI labels, New York synthetic performer law; where AI UGC ads break and when to use real creators

Perlmutter, what Runway, OpenAI, Google Cloud and Kling terms say about output ownership, Canada's unsettled position, and the work-for-hire and assignment clauses for a studio contract
